record.title: The Murim Goes Mad (Novel)
record.description:
The martial world trembles under the shadow of a legend reborn. For three years, the formidable Yi Muk was presumed dead, his name whispered only in tales of unparalleled skill. Now, he has returned, his intentions as sharp and elusive as his blade. His reappearance sends shockwaves through the Jianghu, forcing powerful sects and cunning strategists alike to question everything. The stoic Cold-Hearted Sword Gye So-hyang, who seeks only the pinnacle of swordsmanship, finds her path intertwined with his, as all eyes turn to the man who vanished and returned, leaving a trail of neutralized foes and unanswered questions. 

As Yi Muk navigates a treacherous landscape of shifting alliances and ancient rivalries, his journey with Gye So-hyang leads them towards Hangzhou and the enigmatic Jeok Sang-ran, the current Wol of Golden Moon Hall. Her connection to the prophetic Black Mother hints at deeper secrets. Strategists desperately try to decipher Yi Muk's true purpose, fearing the chaos his presence portends. His past, his abilities, and the reason for his return threaten to shatter the peace of the martial world. The Murim teeters on the brink, its balance threatened by a force it cannot comprehend. Will Yi Muk be its savior or the catalyst that plunges it into irreversible madness? The stage is set for an epic confrontation where the fate of the entire Jianghu hangs by a thread.

**Original Novel:**    
[BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/novel/detail.asp?serial_num=se3086), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/50546520/), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3685035331), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=4299379), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/nov/nov_list.mg?tcode=056k), [Joara](https://www.joara.com/book/1471519) 

**Official Translations:**    
[English](https://genesistudio.com/novels/the-murim-goes-mad)

Her childhood friend Daiki confides in her that he is a virgin too...

record.title: Papa to Kiss in the Dark (Novel)
record.description:
*An extremely popular 4-volume series in Japan with fujoshi!*

**Book 1:** Munekata Mira successfully entered Shirasakura Gakuin. But he is late for the memorable entrance ceremony. The reason was that he had sex in the morning. Moreover, the other party is Kyosuke Munekata, who is playing pheromonally in a TV drama on the big screen. In other words, he is Mira's father. Mira thought he would stop this kind of relationship, but when he learned that Kyousuke and himself weren't a real parent-child relationship, he realized his true feelings.

**Book 2:** Munekata Mira, a first-year student at Shirasakura Gakuin, has a pheromonal actor father, Munekata Kyousuke. But the two are not true parents and child, but a love-love relationship. One day, Mira is invited by his mother, Kyousuke's older sister, Mitsuki Utsunomiya, to go to the villa of the Utsunomiya family. There is also Takayuki Utsunomiya, the student council president of the academy and Mitsuki's son-in-law. Mira and Takayuki kissed for some reason, and in a big uproar involving childhood friend Kazuki Hino ...!? The second in the popular series!

**Book 3:** Munekata Mira, a first-year student at Shirasakura Gakuin High School, and his pheromonal actor father, Kyosuke, is his love-love lover. During the summer vacation, Munekata went to Europe after sticking to Kyousuke, who went on location in a movie, and met a man who looked just like Kyousuke by the lake. It's surprising that the man is Kyousuke's cousin who confesses that he is his real father, but ...!? A very popular series that includes stories about his childhood!

**Book 4:** Munekata Mira, a first-year student at Shirasakura Gakuin, has a love-loving relationship with his father, pheromone actor, Kyosuke Munekata. During the summer vacation, Mira went to Germany with Kyousuke's film location, where he met his cousin, Ryousuke, who looked exactly like Kyousuke. Mira, who has begun to worry about his relationship with Kyousuke, follows Ryousuke, who tells Mira that his true father is himself, and tries to move away from Kyousuke ...!? The fourth installment of the popular series turbulence! !!

record.title: Wagahai wa Neko de Aru ga Inu
record.description:
If I could live again, I'd like to be a cat...independent and not bound by the obsessive desire for human affection. And so, the dog's wish was granted. But before long, misfortune strikes and he stumbles into a river. When hope is all but lost, Miki rushes to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, he decides to dedicate his life to bringing her joy... only to find out that she's a dog person. Refusing to give up, he then vows to become Miki's new dependable "canine"!

-A collection of peculiar yet heartwarming short stories depicting the bond between "cat" and human.

**Note:** Adapted from the author’s oneshot that was released in HaruJam2020 (Season Jam). In 2022, as a oneshot series, some chapters released in Season Jam and Mecha Comic.

[Feel Web releases](https://feelweb.jp/episode/3270296674425314793)

Houjou Mio lost her parents and when she was lost on the streets, a large conglomerate's heir, Kuketsuin Osaki helped her. His true identity is actually the king of youkai, a nine-tailed black fox. And due to some reasons, she has a "fake lovers relationship" with him, but as Mio gradually gets attracted to him, she gets into a real lovers relationship with Kuketsuin. But the suddenly appearing top entertainer, Shiromi Yukinojou, passionately courts Mio and...?! Gorgeous and dazzling! A strange love romance.

Consists of:  
Youko Warning!  
Youko Darling!  
Youko Wedding! (2 volumes)  
Youko + Love x Kiss! (4 volumes)

record.title: City Series (Novel)
record.description:
After the world was recreated countless times, a world that would not be destroyed was created. This marked the beginning of the City era.

From Berlin to Detroit, this series tells the stories of the unique cities that came to be in that world.

It was Kawakami's debut series and it takes place in the final era of Kawakami's light novels, which include Kyoukai Senjou no Horizon, Owari no Chronicle and Gekitotsu no Hexennacht.

record.title: Chi-Chi Series
record.description:
Kwak Chi-eon, who has just turned 20, surprises adults by declaring that he will not go to college, but in fact, he has a clearer goal than anything else. To win Hyun Woo-jong, the older brother next door and his destiny! To my dismay, Woojong, whom I have seen since childhood, is the type of person who is very playful and constantly has light romances. However, he is very sparing with his words and often shows his desire to be exclusive in a confusing way. Chi-eon, who has decided that he has become a proud adult and that it is time to start in earnest, gathers his courage and goes straight to Ujong with single-minded determination... ?!

[Original Novel](https://ridibooks.com/books/3086000732)
